data.name: Lailaah
data.gender_notes: Lailaah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root word 'lail' meaning 'night'. In Islamic culture, Lailaah is a name for the night sky and its twinkling stars. It is also mentioned in the Quran as the name of a female companion of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh). The name Lailaah carries the meaning “Night, Star” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Lailaah usually hope their child will grow to embody night, star and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of tranquility and peace in the night sky.
data.etymology: Lailaah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Night, Star.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Lailaah total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: ليلة
in_arabic.meaning: الليلة تعني الليل أو فترة الظلام في اللغة العربية
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم ليلة مشتق من الجذر اللغوي 'ل-ي-ل' والذي يعني الليل أو فترة الظلام. في اللغة العربية، الليلة هي فترة بين غروب الشمس وشروقها. وفي القرآن الكريم، ذكرت كلمة 'ليلة' في عدة مواضع، منها ليلة القدر في سورة القدر. اسم ليلى أو ليال هو اسم شائع في الثقافة العربية والإسلامية، وغالبًا ما يرتبط بالجمال والهدوء.

in_urdu.name: لیلاہ
in_urdu.meaning: لیلاہ کا مطلب ہے رات یا اندھیرا
in_urdu.long_meaning: لیلاہ نام عربی زبان کی root 'ل-ي-ل' سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے رات یا اندھیرا۔ یہ نام اسلامی ثقافت میں خوبصورتی اور سکون کے ساتھ منسلک ہے۔ جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں میں یہ نام لیلا یا لیلیٰ کے مختلف ہجے میں استعمال ہوتا ہے، اور اس کا روحانی مطلب رات کے وقت کی سکون اور پر سکون کیفیت سے جڑا ہوا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: लीलाह
in_hindi.meaning: लीलाह का अर्थ है रात या अंधेरा
in_hindi.long_meaning: लीलाह नाम की उत्पत्ति 'ल-य-ल' अरबी मूल से हुई है, जिसका अर्थ है रात या अंधेरा। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम अक्सर लैला या लीला के रूप में लिखा जाता है। इस नाम का आध्यात्मिक महत्व रात की शांति और सुकून से जुड़ा है, और यह अक्सर सुंदरता और दिव्यता के प्रतीक के रूप में देखा जाता है।

in_pashto.name: لیلاہ
in_pashto.meaning: لیلاہ د شپې یا تیروارۍ معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: د لیلا نوم د 'ل-ي-ل' عربي ريښې څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې د شپې یا تیروارۍ معنی لري. په افغان او پښتون کلتور کې، دا نوم د شپې د ارام او سولې سره تړلی دی. دا نوم اکثرا د ښکلا او روحانيت د نښه په توګه کارول کیږي.

in_english.name: Lailaah
in_english.meaning: Lailaah means night or darkness, symbolizing beauty and tranquility
in_english.long_meaning: The name Lailaah originates from the Arabic root 'ل-ي-ل' (l-y-l), meaning night or darkness. In Islamic tradition, the name is associated with the serene and peaceful qualities of the night. Lailaah is mentioned in various forms across cultures, including Laila, Leyla, and Leila, all deriving from the same root. The name symbolizes beauty, tranquility, and the mystical aspects of the night, often referenced in Quranic verses and Islamic literature.

data.cultural_impact: The name Lailaah is traditionally used as a feminine given name in the Islamic world. Its association with the night sky and the stars adds a romantic and dreamlike quality to the name.
data.spiritual_significance: Lailaah carries a deeper spiritual meaning in Islamic tradition as well. As mentioned in the Quran, the night journey of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) to the celestial 'AL-Masjid Al-Aqsa' (a significant mosque in Jerusalem) took place on the Night of Destiny, known as 'Lailatul Qadr'. This night is considered one of the best nights for Muslims to seek Allah's forgiveness, make charitable donations, and perform extra prayers. Therefore, the name Lailaah can serve as a constant reminder of the spiritual importance of the night sky and the quest for divine blessings.
